evals.name: pure-helper
evals.prompt: Add unit tests for the mapInstructions helper in src/helpers/recipe.helper.ts. I want both branches covered — when there are timestamps and when there aren't. Put the spec next to the other tests.
evals.expected_output: A *.spec.ts that imports RecipeHelper directly (no mocking, no reflect-metadata needed), covers the timestamps-present and timestamps-absent branches with descriptive names, and runs green.
assertions: Spec runs green: Jest reports all tests passing with 0 failures
Covers the timestamps-absent branch (sequential step numbering, no video times)
Imports RecipeHelper directly with no jest.mock and no Container/reflect-metadata machinery
Test names describe scenario and expected outcome, not vague ('works'/'should be defined')

evals.name: injected-deps-service
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for VideoProcessingService (src/services/video-processing.service.ts). Cover preloadVideo and publishVideo, including the case where the download fails. Don't let it hit real Google Cloud Storage.
evals.expected_output: A *.spec.ts that constructs VideoProcessingService directly with fake LocalVideoManagerService and GoogleStorageService (no Container.get, no real GCS), covers happy + download-failure branches incl. finally cleanup, runs green and isolated.
assertions: Spec runs green: Jest reports all tests passing with 0 failures
Constructs VideoProcessingService directly with fake collaborators (no Container.get)
Does not touch real Google Cloud Storage or the network (GoogleStorageService + LocalVideoManagerService are faked)
Covers the download-failure branch of preloadVideo (and ideally the finally-block cleanup)
Imports 'reflect-metadata' before importing the decorated service
Test names describe scenario and expected outcome, not vague ('works'/'should be defined')

evals.name: orchestrator-llm-service
evals.prompt: I need unit tests for getRecipeMetadata on the RecipeGeneratorService orchestrator (src/services/recipe-generator.service.ts). It calls the scraper and an OpenAI chain. Make sure the tests are fast and don't call OpenAI or the network for real. Cover the not-a-recipe rejection and the happy no-video path at least.
evals.expected_output: A *.spec.ts that jest.mock's @langchain/openai, injects fakes for the other collaborators + logger, relies on the OTel no-op tracer (no OTel mocking), covers the not-a-recipe and happy no-video branches, and runs green without network.
assertions: Spec runs green: Jest reports all tests passing with 0 failures
jest.mock's @langchain/openai (or otherwise prevents any real OpenAI/network call)
Covers the not-a-recipe rejection path (LLM validation returns isRecipe:false -> throws/rejects)
Covers the happy no-video path (valid recipe, no videoUrl -> returns preview metadata)
Constructs the service directly with faked collaborators; does not resolve the real graph via Container.get
Imports 'reflect-metadata' before importing the decorated service
